newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA INAUGURATES DIGITAL PHONE PROJECT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA INAUGURATES DIGITAL PHONE PROJECT.

text.p: Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC) on Friday inaugurated a new fibre optic cable project which will secure 7,560 digital phone lines to connect 26 Bulgarian towns.

The western circuit of the Digital Overlay Network (DON) project was installed at a cost of some 7.5 million pounds sterling by BTC in cooperation with Pirelli Construction Co and U.S.-based Northern Telecom Europe , BTC director Michail Danov told reporters.
The DON circle consist of four optic fibre systems with 1,890 digital phone lines each and 155 megabytes per second speed of data flow. The total length of the optic cable is 818 km, Danov said.
The western DON circuit will secure a direct digital line with Turkey through Bulgaria's southeastern town of Khaskovo.
An eastern DON circuit is also planned, with the final aim of integrating Bulgaria, Yugoslavia, Greece and Turkey in one Balkan DON system.

"This is a good example of useful cooperation between Bulgarian and British industry, as two years ago when I wanted to send a fax I had to say goobye to my secretary for the rest of the day," British ambassador Roger Short said at the ceremony.
BTC is preparing to offer a 25 percent stake for privatisation next year.
